title: pinalia graciliscapa
intro: Pinalia graciliscapa, commonly known as the "Gentle Spirit", is a species of orchid native to Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Pinalia graciliscapa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit analgesic and sedative effects. As a result, Pinalia graciliscapa is used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic actions, including treating fever, cough, and digestive issues.
